name: FFS_DWH_EXPORT_HIST_FILE
description: Stores history of Daily Extract runs for particular files.

columns.name: DWH_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Daily Extract History record. Reference to DWH Export History.

columns.name: FILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Daily Extract History File record. Reference to DWH Export History File table.

columns.name: CHANNEL_SUBMETHOD
columns.description: Channel submethod from message_agent(equal to channel_id).

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the extraction: completed, failed.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Path to the file a data was extracted to.

columns.name: STARTED_AT
columns.description: Stores date and time when file extraction was started.

columns.name: FINISHED_AT
columns.description: Stores date and time when extraction was finished.

columns.name: EXPORTED_ROWS
columns.description: Number of exported entities in the file.

columns.name: FAILED_ROWS
columns.description: Number of failed entities in the file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
